{{Quote|I beg Darth's pardon &lt;choke&gt; pardon me. I seem to be having trouble breathing.|Taed Augustus, just before being killed by Darth Vader|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
'''Taed Augustus''' was the [[Director of Sienar Marketing Relations]] for [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer, shortly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Augustus made a presentation to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] about the specialized [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] prototype starship. Augustus was [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choked]] to [[Death/Legends|death]] by Vader when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] took insult at Augustus's overtures of familiarity, calling Vader "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]]" more than once during the presentation.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taed Augustus was mentioned in the "TIE Advanced" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUII" />
